response.reason: The Fast-InvSqrt seed plus three Newton iterations yields reciprocal-sqrt relative error well below FP32 rounding (~1e-7), so the FP32 computation of x/sqrt(1+x*x) stays far within the 1e-6 absolute tolerance for all finite FP16 inputs, including ±65504 and subnormals/zeros.
